title: Bridge Glb Path Resolution
description: Fix places where bridge.glb and other metabolism representation files resolve to wrong paths (stale assets/semio/metabolism vs fixtures/kit/dev/metabolism/representations).
summary: Puzzle 3d showed placeholder/wrong bridge because sketchpadKitFileUrlById could not map bridge file id to /meshes/bridge.glb: GraphQL hasFiles omitted file name (only id/url/description), and inline data: blobs took precedence over fixture meshes. Fixed by adding name to SKETCHPAD_KIT_READ_INNER, preferring /meshes/* for metabolism *.glb kit files before blobs, and merging typology-backed types in sketchpadMergeKitDtoFromBundleProjection.
